profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, UI/UX
profile.summary:
As a UI/UX engineer, I have extensive experience developing and designing user interfaces for a variety of applications, including educational simulations, web platforms, and websites. I have a strong command of both design and front-end development, using technologies such as HTML, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript, Angular, React and TypeScript. 

Having worked with various clients over the years, I have learned the importance of effective communication in understanding their needs and delivering solutions that align with their objectives. I pride myself on my ability to collaborate directly with clients and stakeholders, ensuring that their vision is translated into the final product.

I work extensively contributing accessibility standards and compliance, specifically with Section 508, ADA, WCAG 2.0, and WCAG 2.1 success criteria of level A, AA, and AAA. This allows me to ensure that the user interfaces I design and develop are accessible to everyone, including those with disabilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, UI/UX
positions.description:
Develop, design, and implement user interfaces for educational simulations used by Harvard Business School students and distributed worldwide through Harvard Business Publishing.

Work closely with faculty to gather requirements and develop real-time administrative data visualizations to track student simulation progress.

Perform accessibility audits of web applications to ensure code accessibility compliance with Section 508, ADA, WCAG 2.0, and WCAG 2.1 success criteria of level A, AA, and AAA.

Work closely with project managers, subject matter experts and quality engineers, to create state-of-the-art interactive user interfaces for custom teaching and learning products.

Contribute to, and use, a set of existing common code libraries and participate in design and code reviews.

positions.title: Front-end Developer
positions.description:
Developed, designed, and managed requirements for the myHBS student platform in collaboration with the Master of Business Administration department and students.

Led development of a reusable component library for hbs.edu that fulfilled branding guidelines.

Managed over 20 internal and external websites while working closely with clients.

positions.title: Web Developer / Systems Admin
positions.description:
Development of web pages using HTML 5, CSS3, Bootstrap, PHP and JavaScript.

Collaborated with project managers and designers to develop web applications and pages.

Carried out quality assurance and accessibility tests to optimize usability.

Worked directly with clients to provide frontend and backend support for integrated content management systems. (Drupal, WordPress, ExpressionEngine)
positions.insights: Skills: Defining Requirements · Web Accessibility · User Experience (UX)

positions.title: Quality Assurance Intern
positions.description: Developed use cases and test plans for educational mobile applications.

positions.title: Data Analyst Intern
positions.description:
Configured and optimized ETL tools and processes.

Pulled campaign performance data from partner platforms (Kenshoo, Marin, MediaPlex, Facebook, Criteo, etc.) and industry standard web traffic platforms (Google Analytics, WebTrends, etc.)
